reserves.name: Issuer-reported physical gold in HKGX-recognised depositories (allocation unverified)

reserveReview.rationale: The complete issuer-described reserve category is physical gold; 100% records promised backing type, not verified bars, allocated title or sufficiency. Homepage identifies GoldZip Digital Pte. Ltd. as an HKGX group member and the litepaper describes issuance by an HKGX wholly owned subsidiary. HKGX both affiliates with the issuer and recognizes refiners/depositories: this related-party concentration is not independent custody or assurance. No current MinLaw register confirmation or PSPM credit is inferred from issuer marketing.
